ns2:course.label: Landscape Plants Production
ns2:course.description: Emphasizes woody landscape plant production, nursery operation, and nursery business management techniques; includes both traditional and computer-aided management tools; examines industry scope and diversity through nursery visits, presentations by nursery operators, and field trips. Offered in alternate years. Prerequisite: NRES 302 or HORT 301 and HORT 240.
